name: daily
sql: CREATE TABLE daily (day INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, summary TEXT NOT NULL)

name: diagnostics
sql: CREATE TABLE diagnostics (id BLOB PRIMARY KEY, timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL)

name: feedback
sql: CREATE TABLE feedback (id BLOB PRIMARY KEY, usefulness TEXT NOT NULL)

name: meta
sql: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

name: seen
sql: CREATE TABLE seen (sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id BLOB UNIQUE NOT NULL, timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL)
